subject: English
question_text: Read the beginning of a story. Add at least ten new sentences to complete the story.
stimulus: In an early morning I wake up from the horizon of dream. A feel of despair shadowed my psyche with gloominess of losing the sweet dream. Suddenly a mysterious joyous thrill rippled my veins owing back to senses that reminded that it is a special day to enjoy our one day study tour. Instantly I jumped from my bed
